buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 3. Generic Buyer Organization specific Integrity Pact shall have to be complied by all bidders. Bidders shall have to upload scanned copy of signed integrity pact as per Buyer organizations policy along with bid. Click here to view the file 4. Generic (a) Third party inspection is to be carried out by BUYER’S approved Third party inspection agency i.e. by IRS / Lloyds /RITES / Bureau Veritas / DNV and TUBOSCOPE VETCO. (b) Raw material inspection for Chemical composition & Mechanical Properties. (c) Verification of certificate provided by the supplier for raw material from reputed manufacturer like TATA, SAIL, etc. specifying clearly suitability of material for manufacturing of pipe. (d) Finished Tube Inspection: Checking dimensions, wall thickness, end bevelling, threading / gauging, surface imperfections etc. 5% of the tubes at random will be checked / tested by Third Party Inspection agency. (e) Pneumatic / Hydraulic Testing : 10% of the pipes at random will be tested pneumatically / hydraulically by Third Party Inspection agency. The above test procedure is for offering to Third Party Inspection agency, whereas manufacturer will do testing of the entire quantity of pipe before offering to Third Party Inspection agency. The manufacturer will forward the various test certificates of their own testing after checked / verified / certified by the Third Party Inspection agency. (f) The above specification & testing should be as per IS: 1239(PART :1) (latest) and IS:554 (latest). 5. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any.

6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses IMPORTANT NOTES TO BIDDERS Mandatory requirements to avoid rejection/disqualification of the bid Bidders are advised to carefully read the complete GeM Bid Document and HPCL Tender Document before submission. The following requirements shall be complied with, wherever applicable: 1. Mandatory forms and declarations: All prescribed tender forms, declarations and supporting docu ments shall be duly filled, signed, stamped and uploaded with the bid. Incomplete or non-submission of ma ndatory documents may result in rejection of the bid. 2. Earnest Money Deposit: EMD of Rs. 6,00,000/- shall be submitted in the prescribed form and mode . Bidders claiming exemption shall upload valid supporting documents establishing eligibility for the exem ption. Where MSE exemption is claimed for procurement of goods, the bidder shall establish eligibility as a n eligible manufacturer; traders shall not claim exemption unless specifically permitted under the tender c onditions. 3. Hard copy/original EMD submission: Where submission of physical EMD is applicable, the bidder sh all upload the relevant EMD document on the GeM portal and ensure that the hard copy/original EMD reac hes HPCL within five (5) days from the GeM tender due date at the following address: Box No. 7 Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited A Wing, 9th Floor, Marathon Futurex Mafatlal Mill Compound, N. M. Joshi Marg Lower Parel, Mumbai - 400013 Bidders claiming valid EMD exemption shall upload the prescribed supporting documents. Non-submission of the required EMD may lead to rejection of the bid. 4. Integrity Pact: The Integrity Pact shall be duly completed, signed and submitted with the bid. Non- submission of the prescribed signed Integrity Pact may render the bid liable for rejection. 5. Technical experience documents: Documentary evidence for the prescribed technical experience s hall be uploaded, including relevant Purchase Order(s) and Completion, Commissioning or Performance Ce rtificate(s) demonstrating completion of similar supply/work as required under the Pre-Qualification Criteria . 6. Financial qualification documents: Audited Annual Reports, Balance Sheets and Profit and Loss Sta tements for the prescribed financial years, including 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 where required by the tender, shall be uploaded. 7. OEM authorization: Where the bidder is not the OEM, a tender-specific OEM/Manufacturer Authoriz ation Form shall be submitted. The bidder shall produce the original OEM-signed authorization for verificati on whenever required by HPCL. 8. PESO and explosion-proof certification: A valid PESO licence and applicable Explosion Proof Certific ation for the offered equipment shall be submitted with the technical/unpriced bid. 9. Clause-wise technical compliance: The bidder shall submit 100% clause-wise technical compliance for the offered intrinsically safe tablet. The make and model offered shall be clearly stated against the tec hnical specifications, and the compliance statement shall be signed by the bidder’s authorized representat ive. 10. Service-centre details: The list of service centres in India for the offered intrinsically safe tablet sh all be submitted on the bidder’s letterhead.

11. GST, PAN and statutory documents: The bidder shall upload the GST Registration Certificate, PAN and other applicable statutory documents. Latest GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B shall also be submitted where pres cribed in the tender checklist. 12. Udyam registration: A valid Udyam Registration Certificate shall be uploaded wherever MSE benefi ts, preference or EMD exemption are claimed. MSE benefits shall not be claimed without valid documentar y evidence. 13. Make in India declaration: The applicable Make in India declaration/local-content certificate shall b e submitted. The bidder shall correctly declare whether the offered product qualifies as a Class-I or Class-II Local Supplier in accordance with the tender requirements. 14. No price disclosure in technical bid: No price, rate or monetary amount shall be disclosed anywher e in the technical/unpriced bid. In the GST declaration, only the applicable GST percentage shall be mentio ned. Disclosure of price information in the technical/unpriced bid may render the bid liable for rejection. 15. GST-inclusive price: The quoted price shall be inclusive of GST. The bidder shall clearly indicate th e applicable GST percentage considered in the quoted price, as required by the tender. 16. Signing authority: Power of Attorney, Board Resolution or other valid authorization of the person si gning the bid shall be submitted, as applicable to the constitution of the bidder. 17. Document quality: All uploaded documents shall be clear, complete, legible and non-password-pro tected. Illegible, incomplete, corrupted or inaccessible mandatory documents may result in the bid being tr eated as non-responsive. 18. Prescribed formats: All applicable tender forms shall be properly completed. Alternatives shall be t icked or struck out wherever required. The prescribed wording and format of declarations shall not be alter ed. 19. Complete and unconditional offer: The bidder shall quote for the complete tendered requirement. Conditional, alternative or partial offers shall not be submitted unless specifically permitted in the tender. Important: Non-submission, incomplete submission or non-compliance with any mandatory tender require ment may render the bid liable for rejection. Bidders shall not assume that documents can be furnished aft er bid opening unless clarification is specifically sought by HPCL through the GeM portal. . 7.
